items.docs: Slack invokes this endpoint when a user runs `/nuon <subcommand>` in any channel of an installed workspace. Authenticated via the Slack signing-secret middleware (X-Slack-Signature + X-Slack-Request-Timestamp); not via API key. Subcommands: subscribe, unsubscribe, status, help. Responses are ephemeral.

Receives lifecycle events from Slack: url_verification (handshake), app_uninstalled (workspace removed Nuon), tokens_revoked (bot token invalidated). Authenticated via Slack signing-secret middleware (X-Slack-Signature + X-Slack-Request-Timestamp); not via API key. Returns 200 even for unhandled event types so Slack does not retry.

Receives interactive payloads (view_submission, block_actions, block_suggestion, shortcut). Authenticated via Slack signing-secret middleware (X-Slack-Signature + X-Slack-Request-Timestamp); not via API key. Dispatches subscribe/unsubscribe modal submissions, block_actions (scope/notif radios, Remove buttons), and the install picker's external_select block_suggestion handshake. Returns 200 on every parseable envelope so Slack does not retry; unhandled payload types are logged and acked.

params.name: state
params.description: Signed state JWT issued by GetInstallURL

items.docs: Receives the OAuth `code` + signed-state JWT from Slack, exchanges the code for a workspace bot token via oauth.v2.access, persists the installation + org link, and redirects to the dashboard. NOT signed by Slack — trust comes from the state JWT signature. Enterprise Grid (org-wide) installs are rejected.

info.name: List Slack channel subscriptions for the current org

items.docs: Returns the per-channel routing rules belonging to the calling org's verified Slack org links.
Subscribes a Slack channel to events for the current org. The org_link_id must resolve to a verified SlackOrgLink belonging to the calling org; this is enforced at the DB query level (ABAC).

Mutates a per-channel routing rule. Pass only the fields you want to change. Updating `match` may collide with the `(team_id, channel_id, org_link_id, match_canonical)` unique index — the API returns 409 with a clear description in that case so the dashboard can render the same toast it shows on a duplicate create. The subscription must belong to the calling org (ABAC enforced at the DB query level).
Soft-deletes a SlackChannelSubscription belonging to the current org. ABAC scoped at the DB query so callers cannot delete subscriptions outside their org.

info.name: Get the Slack OAuth install URL for the current org

items.docs: Returns a Slack OAuth v2 authorize URL with a signed state JWT bound to the calling account and org. The dashboard redirects the user to this URL to begin the install flow.

info.name: List Slack workspaces linked to the current org

items.docs: Returns every active Slack workspace installation that has a verified org link to the calling org.

info.name: List channels visible to a Slack installation

items.docs: Calls Slack's conversations.list using the installation's bot token and returns the page of channels the bot can see. The installation must belong to a verified org link for the calling org.

info.name: List Slack workspace bindings for the current org

items.docs: Returns the verified SlackOrgLink rows belonging to the calling org. Each row carries the link_id used by the channel-subscription create endpoint.

info.name: Bind a Slack workspace to the current org

items.docs: Creates a verified SlackOrgLink between the supplied TeamID and the calling org. Used by the Phase 4 confirmation flow when a user finishes the Slack OAuth round-trip and selects the Nuon org to attach the workspace to.

info.name: Revoke a Slack workspace ↔ org binding

items.docs: Soft-deletes the SlackOrgLink. Channel subscriptions cascade off via the FK. Idempotent if the link is already revoked.
